item.title: A message from Mr. Warner:
item.description: Last announcement for EOSSAA - promise! I would like to thank my assistant coaches, Ms. Burnie and Mr. Cecillon for their help, guidance and, support this year. It is a huge committment and difficult to do on your own. Thank you so much, I couldn't do this without you. To our junior girls' team, I said from the beginning that you were such a pleasure to coach and such a good group of girls. Even though we didn't come out on top on Tuesday, we couldn't be more proud of you, how you competed, and how you carried yourself! You continue to represent STA with heart and class! Congratulations on a great season :) Team party to follow!

item.title: A message from Mrs. Longval:
item.description: Attention STA students! Just a quick reminder that the deadline to register your Grades 9–12 dodgeball team is this Monday, November 23! Registration sheets are located outside Mrs. Longval's office, so get your team together and don't miss out! 🥸 MOVEMBER FACT OF THE DAY! Did you know that Movember focuses on three major areas of men's health: mental health and suicide prevention, prostate cancer, and testicular cancer? Movember is about more than growing a moustache. It's about raising awareness, starting important conversations and encouraging men to take care of their physical and mental health. Speaking of moustaches... do you know someone who's growing a moustache this Movember? If you do, give them a high-five and congratulate them for helping raise awareness for such an important cause! Sometimes even a moustache can start a conversation that makes a difference! Let's keep showing our STA school spirit and make this year's tournament a great one, all for an important cause! Have a great Friday, STA!
